description: PHASE 3 SLICE 3 — First-class, INDEXED relations for discovery-readiness: server-backed SAVES/bookmarks, RICHER REACTIONS (beyond a single like), HASHTAGS, MENTIONS, and LOCATION tags. Today bookmarks are local-only (PostRepository.toggleBookmark keeps no server row) and hashtags/mentions are only cosmetically linkified in PostCard. This slice makes them first-class, INDEXED relations so a later search/discovery phase (roadmap phase_5) is cheap. Add migration 0007 with: public.saves (server-backed bookmarks), public.reactions (typed reactions with a server-owned per-type count model), public.hashtags + public.post_hashtags, public.post_mentions, and posts.location (+ optional lat/lng), each with author-inherited or owner-scoped RLS and the indexes a search phase needs (hashtag tag lookup, mention-of-user lookup, saves-by-user). Wire the client minimally + safely: SaveRepository (server-backed bookmarks replacing the local-only toggle while preserving the optimistic single-notify contract and existing tests), a pure hashtag/mention EXTRACTOR used to populate the relations on compose, a reactions abstraction on the Post model + a reaction picker on PostCard (long-press the like button), and an optional location field on compose. Depends on FEAT-008 (content model) — hashtags/mentions are extracted from post.content.
steps: PURE EXTRACTOR — lib/utils/text_entities.dart: pure functions `Set<String> extractHashtags(String content)` and `Set<String> extractMentions(String content)` reusing the SAME token grammar the PostCard linkifier uses (RegExp r'#([A-Za-z0-9_]+)' and r'@([A-Za-z0-9_\.]+)') returning NORMALIZED, de-duped tokens (hashtags lower-cased without the leading '#'; mentions lower-cased without the leading '@'). Document that these feed the post_hashtags/post_mentions relations. Fully unit-testable, no Supabase.

MODEL — reactions on lib/models/post.dart: add `ReactionType` enum {like, love, laugh, wow, sad, angry} and on Post a `Map<ReactionType,int> reactionCounts` (default const {}) plus `ReactionType? myReaction` (the viewer's current reaction, null if none). KEEP the existing `liked`/`likeCount` fields working as a compatibility view: `liked` is true when myReaction != null (or specifically == like — choose like-implies-liked and document it); `likeCount` remains the server-owned aggregate like counter. Update copyWith to carry reactionCounts/myReaction. Add an optional `String? location` field (+ optional double? lat, double? lng) to Post with copyWith. Preserve id-based ==/hashCode and the FEAT-008 attachments/kind fields. Document that reactions generalize the single like WITHOUT removing likeCount (server owns counts via triggers).

REPOSITORY — SAVES: create lib/data/save_repository.dart — ChangeNotifier singleton SaveRepository.instance, seeded from MockData.savedPostIds() (EMPTY by default so existing bookmark/feed assertions do not shift), synchronous `bool isSaved(String postId)` + `Set<String> savedIds`, mutator `void toggleSave(String postId)` (optimistic, single notify, idempotent-safe) with guarded fire-and-forget persist to public.saves (insert/delete keyed by (user_id=auth.uid(), post_id)), and a guarded load() hydrating saves for the signed-in user with a setEquals change-guard. Then REWIRE PostRepository.toggleBookmark and PostCard's bookmark action to drive SaveRepository (the Post.bookmarked flag can be sourced from SaveRepository.isSaved for display), keeping the optimistic single-notify contract. Do NOT break post_repository_test.dart: if toggleBookmark's signature/behavior changes, adapt deliberately and keep a test proving bookmark toggling still works; SaveRepository starts empty so default feeds are unchanged.

REPOSITORY — REACTIONS: add a reactions mutator path. Extend PostRepository with `Post? react(String postId, ReactionType type)` and `Post? clearReaction(String postId)` that update myReaction + reactionCounts optimistically (single notify) and persist to public.reactions via guarded fire-and-forget (insert/upsert (user_id, post_id, type) / delete), mirroring _persistLike. IMPORTANT: keep toggleLike working as a thin wrapper (like/unlike maps to react(like)/clearReaction) so existing like tests + the PostCard like button keep passing; the server owns per-type counts via a trigger (documented). mapPostRow should populate reactionCounts from an aggregated reactions join when present and myReaction from the viewer's own reaction row (guarded, defaults empty), leaving likeCount from the row as-is.

UI — PostCard: add a reaction picker — LONG-PRESS (or long-press the like ActionButton) opens a small horizontal popover of the 6 reaction emojis; tapping one calls PostRepository.react; tapping the currently-selected clears it; a plain tap on the like button remains the quick like/unlike (react(like)/clear) so existing behavior is unchanged. Reflect myReaction on the like button (colored + the chosen glyph). Keep the action row layout intact. Bookmark action now reflects SaveRepository.isSaved and calls toggleSave. Hashtags/mentions in the caption stay linkified as today.

UI — COMPOSE: add an optional location field (a single-line 'Add location' text input with a place icon in the compose toolbar/sheet) that sets the composed Post.location. On post, extract hashtags + mentions from the content via text_entities and pass them through addPost so PostRepository._persistNewPost can (guarded) populate post_hashtags/post_mentions after inserting the post. Mark the '// PHASE 4/5 SEAM' where a real place-picker/geocoder would replace the free-text location.

MIGRATION — supabase/migrations/0007_relations.sql (NEW): (a) public.saves (user_id, post_id, created_at, pk (user_id, post_id)) RLS insert/delete/select own; index idx_saves_user on (user_id, created_at desc). (b) public.reactions (user_id, post_id, type text check in the 6 types, created_at, pk (user_id, post_id)) — one reaction per user per post; RLS insert/delete/select-own-or-viewable-post (select mirrors likes_select_viewable); index idx_reactions_post_type on (post_id, type). Add a server-owned aggregate: either keep posts.like_count in sync for type='like' (a sync_post_reaction_like_count trigger mirroring sync_post_like_count but counting reactions where type='like') OR document that likes and reactions coexist — choose ONE and document it clearly to avoid double-counting (recommended: reactions is the general table; keep the existing likes table + sync_post_like_count untouched for 'like', and reactions covers the OTHER 5 types, OR migrate like into reactions with the trigger recomputing like_count from reactions where type='like'. Pick the migrate-into-reactions approach and DROP nothing from 0001; add the trigger; document the coexistence explicitly). (c) public.hashtags (id uuid pk, tag text unique not null, created_at) + public.post_hashtags (post_id, hashtag_id, pk (post_id, hashtag_id)); RLS: hashtags readable by authenticated (using true — tags are public discovery data), post_hashtags select mirrors post visibility, insert scoped to the post owner; indexes idx_hashtags_tag on (tag), idx_post_hashtags_hashtag on (hashtag_id) so 'posts for #tag' is cheap. (d) public.post_mentions (post_id, mentioned_user uuid, pk (post_id, mentioned_user)); RLS select mirrors post visibility, insert scoped to post owner; index idx_post_mentions_user on (mentioned_user) so 'posts mentioning me' is cheap. (e) posts.location text + posts.lat double precision + posts.lng double precision via add column if not exists; index idx_posts_location on (location) (partial where location is not null). All idempotent. Head comment: purpose, the reactions-vs-likes coexistence decision, and ENV RISK (UNVERIFIED live, structural review only).

MOCKDATA — add `static Set<String> savedPostIds() => {}` (empty). Optionally seed a couple of reactionCounts on existing posts if it does not shift existing like/count assertions — SAFER to leave reactionCounts empty by default and only exercise reactions via mapPostRow tests + the react() mutator tests, so existing feed assertions are untouched. Confirm against post_repository_test.dart before adding any non-empty reaction seed.

TESTS — test/text_entities_test.dart: extractHashtags/extractMentions are case-insensitive, strip the sigil, de-dupe, handle none/multiple, and match the linkifier grammar (e.g. '#Design and #design' => {'design'}; '@Nova_Labs' => {'nova_labs'}; punctuation boundaries). test/save_repository_test.dart: toggleSave adds/removes with single notify + idempotent-safe; isSaved reflects state; savedIds unmodifiable; offline load no-op firing zero notifications. Extend test/post_repository_test.dart: react() sets myReaction + increments the right reactionCounts bucket with single notify; clearReaction/re-react transitions counts correctly; toggleLike still works via the react wrapper (liked flips, likeCount +/-1); mapPostRow populates reactionCounts/myReaction from a reactions join and stays empty when absent; bookmark toggling via SaveRepository still works. Do NOT weaken existing assertions; adapt only where the model genuinely changed and document why.

DOCS + VERIFY — update README.md documenting saves (server-backed), reactions, hashtags/mentions as indexed relations feeding a future search phase, and location tags, plus the ENV RISK. Run `flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test` with the toolchain env vars; no new analyzer issues; all tests green; discard the analysis_options.yaml exclude block; confirm 0001-0006 unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: lib/utils/text_entities.dart provides pure, tested extractHashtags/extractMentions matching the PostCard linkifier grammar (normalized, de-duped)

SaveRepository is a server-backed ChangeNotifier singleton (optimistic single-notify, guarded persist to public.saves, offline load no-op); PostCard bookmark + PostRepository.toggleBookmark drive it without breaking existing tests

Post carries reactionCounts + myReaction (with liked/likeCount kept as a compatibility view) and optional location/lat/lng; PostRepository.react/clearReaction persist to public.reactions with toggleLike kept working as a thin wrapper
PostCard exposes a 6-type reaction picker via long-press while a plain like tap is unchanged; compose supports an optional location and extracts hashtags/mentions on post

supabase/migrations/0007_relations.sql adds saves, reactions, hashtags+post_hashtags, post_mentions, and posts.location/lat/lng — all INDEXED for discovery and with author-inherited/owner-scoped RLS, idempotent, documenting the reactions-vs-likes coexistence; migrations 0001-0006 unchanged
New + extended tests pass (text_entities, save_repository, reactions/mapPostRow/toggleLike-wrapper) without weakening existing assertions
`flutter analyze` reports only the 8 baseline INFO lints and `flutter test` passes (all prior + new)
verification: export HOME=/tmp/fakehome PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH" PUB_CACHE=/opt/pub-cache && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test

Confirm via read: text_entities extractors; SaveRepository server-backed + rewired bookmark; Post.react/clearReaction + reactionCounts/myReaction with toggleLike wrapper; PostCard long-press reaction picker; 0007 has indexes idx_post_hashtags_hashtag / idx_post_mentions_user / idx_saves_user and documents the reactions-vs-likes decision
git diff --stat confirms 0001-0006 unchanged; analysis_options.yaml exclude block not committed
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (all steps + acceptance criteria). (1) lib/utils/text_entities.dart: pure extractHashtags (r'#([A-Za-z0-9_]+)') / extractMentions (r'@([A-Za-z0-9_\.]+)') matching the PostCard linkifier grammar, normalized lower-case + de-duped. (2) lib/models/post.dart: added ReactionType {like,love,laugh,wow,sad,angry}, reactionCounts (default const {}), myReaction, and optional location/lat/lng; kept liked/likeCount as a COMPATIBILITY VIEW under the like-implies-liked rule (liked == (myReaction == like)); `liked` is now a getter derived from myReaction, the ctor accepts liked:true to seed myReaction=like, copyWith carries myReaction/reactionCounts/location and adds clearMyReaction flag (needed because a null myReaction arg is indistinguishable from 'unchanged'). FEAT-008 kind/attachments preserved. (3) lib/data/save_repository.dart: server-backed SaveRepository (ChangeNotifier singleton, seeded EMPTY from MockData.savedPostIds(), optimistic single-notify toggleSave, guarded persist to public.saves keyed by (user_id,post_id), guarded load with setEquals change-guard, offline no-op). PostRepository.toggleBookmark rewired to drive it (bookmarked sourced from SaveRepository.isSaved); PostCard bookmark reflects it via AnimatedBuilder(SaveRepository.instance). (4) PostRepository.react()/clearReaction() persist to public.reactions via _persistReaction (upsert onConflict user_id,post_id / delete), replacing _persistLike; toggleLike kept as a THIN WRAPPER over react(like)/clearReaction; mapPostRow populates reactionCounts (from a `reactions` grouped array or a `reaction_counts` map) + myReaction (from my_reaction/viewer_reaction field, else legacy likedIds => like), defaults empty; addPost accepts hashtags/mentions and _persistNewPost guarded-populates public.hashtags/post_hashtags + post_mentions (username->id lookup) and writes location/lat/lng. (5) lib/widgets/post_card.dart: 6-type reaction picker via LONG-PRESS on the like button (horizontal emoji popover dialog); plain tap = quick like/unlike; a non-like reaction renders its emoji glyph + like count; bookmark reflects SaveRepository. (6) lib/screens/compose_screen.dart: optional free-text 'Add location' field (PHASE 4/5 SEAM noted) + extractHashtags/extractMentions on post passed through addPost. (7) supabase/migrations/0007_relations.sql (NEW, idempotent): public.saves, public.reactions (+ sync_post_reaction_like_count trigger), public.hashtags + public.post_hashtags, public.post_mentions, posts.location/lat/lng; indexes idx_saves_user, idx_reactions_post_type, idx_hashtags_tag, idx_post_hashtags_hashtag, idx_post_mentions_user, partial idx_posts_location; author-inherited RLS (mirrors likes_select_viewable/comments via can_view_profile) + owner-scoped inserts; hashtags select using true (public discovery, documented). REACTIONS-vs-LIKES DECISION (documented in the migration head comment + README): chose MIGRATE-LIKE-INTO-REACTIONS — reactions is the general client-writable store for all 6 types incl. 'like'; posts.like_count recomputed from reactions where type='like' by the new trigger; 0001 public.likes + sync_post_like_count left UNTOUCHED but DORMANT (client no longer writes likes) so like_count has exactly one writer => NO double-counting. Noted the 0002 notify_on_like trigger fires on likes inserts, so reaction-path 'like' notifications are intentionally out of scope this slice (documented). MockData.savedPostIds() => {} (empty); no reaction seeds so existing feed/like/count assertions are unchanged. VERIFICATION: flutter pub get + flutter analyze (8 baseline INFO lints only, exit 0, NO new issues, used .withValues) + flutter test => 193/193 passing (155 baseline + 38 new across text_entities_test.dart, save_repository_test.dart, and the extended post_repository_test.dart). analysis_options.yaml exclude-block auto-append discarded via git checkout; 0001-0006 unchanged (only 0007 added). ENV RISK: 0007 is UNVERIFIED against a live Supabase project (no reachable/administerable instance, no service-role key) — structural review only; live RLS enforcement, the reaction-count trigger, FK/uniqueness constraints, and index creation must be validated on a real project. TEST NOTE: adapted one new toggleLike-wrapper test to normalize via clearReaction first because the seed's first post starts liked (likeCount already includes the like); no existing assertions were weakened.

PHASE 3 v1 REVIEW FIXES (2026-09-08-133217-review.md):
(1 — BLOCKING, reaction read-path split-brain) FIXED. lib/data/post_repository.dart: _viewerEngagement now reads the viewer's own reactions from public.reactions (select 'post_id, type' eq user_id) into a Map<String,ReactionType> instead of the dormant public.likes table, carrying the ACTUAL reaction type (love/laugh/… not a forced like). _ViewerEngagement swapped its `liked` Set<String> for a `reactions` Map<String,ReactionType>. mapPostRow gained a `viewerReactions` map param (precedence: joined my_reaction/viewer_reaction field > viewerReactions[id] > legacy likedIds/reactedIds => like); legacy likedIds/reactedIds kept for back-compat. load()/loadMore() selects now include `reactions(type)` so reactionCounts hydrates from the join; _reactionCountsFromRow handles both the pre-aggregated {type,count} shape and a plain un-aggregated {type} row (each counts as one). Net: a like/reaction made this session survives a server-backed reload with the correct type, and a like keeps the legacy `liked` view lit (like-implies-liked). Guarded/offline-no-op preserved. Tests added in post_repository_test.dart: viewerReactions type hydration, like-lights-liked, absent-post no-op, reactionCounts from a plain reactions(type) join, and a full like/react round-trips-through-reload test (issue 1).
(2 — copyWith clearing) CONFIRMED + documented + tested. copyWith already supports clearing via clearMyReaction and setting a non-like reaction via myReaction: (which reads liked==false on its own); expanded the doc comment in lib/models/post.dart spelling out the 4-step precedence and added a `Post.copyWith reaction resolution` test group (clear lowers non-like to null; non-like reaction reads liked=false; liked:false clears; bare copyWith carries unchanged). No behavior change needed.
(3 — story markSeen during initState) FIXED. lib/screens/story_viewer_screen.dart: the initial _startCurrent() call in initState (which calls markSeen -> notifyListeners) is now deferred to a WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback (mounted-guarded), keeping the notify out of the build phase.
(4 — reaction-path likes produce no notification) FIXED via NEW migration supabase/migrations/0009_reaction_notify.sql (idempotent, head comment + ENV RISK note, structural-review-only). Adds notify_on_reaction_like on public.reactions mirroring notify_on_like: guarded self-notify (post_owner<>actor) + is_blocked, fires on insert/update only for type='like' (switch-to-like on update, no re-notify when already like), emits the byte-identical type='like'+entity_type='post' payload so existing consumers are unchanged. Only 'like' notifies; the other five affect types are a documented later-phase deferral. README updated to document 0009. Migrations 0001-0008 remain byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff --stat empty).
VERIFICATION (post-fix): flutter pub get + flutter analyze (exit 0, ONLY the 8 baseline INFO lints, NO new issues) + flutter test => 216/216 passing (207 baseline + 9 new). analysis_options.yaml auto-appended exclude block discarded via git checkout before commit.
